consumer_universe: all_project_environment for every direct and transitive consumer count

direct_fan_in.formula_or_definition: number of distinct project declarations with a direct edge to the ranked declaration

downstream_consumer_chapters.formula_or_definition: number of audit-classified chapters among transitive downstream consumers

downstream_consumer_domains.formula_or_definition: number of audit-classified domains among transitive downstream consumers

downstream_consumer_layers.formula_or_definition: number of audit-classified layers among transitive downstream consumers

downstream_consumer_modules.formula_or_definition: number of distinct owner modules among transitive downstream consumers

downstream_depth.formula_or_definition: longest reverse-consumer path length in the SCC condensation DAG

transitive_downstream_consumers.formula_or_definition: number of distinct reverse-reachable project consumer declarations, excluding self

reused_low_in_hierarchy_product.interpretation: ranking heuristic for declarations combining broad reverse reach with a long reverse-consumer chain
limitations: It is not a cohesion score and must not be aggregated across the library.
The multiplicative scale conflates two different properties and is dominated by large reach values.
Depth is measured on the SCC condensation graph and layers/domains are not part of the formula.
A high value shows internal consumption, not public API quality or source faithfulness.
